# Michaels Global Trading

> Toronto-based commercial liquidation company specializing in office furniture liquidation, IT equipment decommissioning, warehouse cleanouts, and sustainable asset disposition across Canada. Founded in 2013, serving businesses from small offices to Fortune 500 with end-to-end liquidation, decommissioning, donation coordination, and certified recycling.

Michaels Global Trading (MGT) is a Canadian commercial liquidation and decommissioning company headquartered in downtown Toronto, serving businesses across the Greater Toronto Area, Ontario, Quebec, and the rest of Canada. The company manages the full lifecycle of surplus business assets — assessment, removal, transportation, resale, donation, and certified recycling — with documented chain of custody for data-bearing devices and diversion summaries for ESG reporting. Insured crews handle dock and elevator bookings, finishes protection, and broom-clean handover for lease-compliant exits.

**Contact:** +1-647-496-6362 | sales@michaelsglobaltrading.com
**Address:** 65 Shuter St Suite 114, Toronto, ON M5B 1B2, Canada
**Hours:** Monday–Friday 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM, Saturday 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST
**Founded:** 2013

## Core Services

### Office Furniture Services
- [Office Furniture Liquidation](https://www.michaelsglobaltrading.com/services/office-furniture-liquidation): Planned resale, donation, and removal of surplus office furnishings during closures, relocations, or renovations. Includes itemized estimates and projected resale credits.
- [Office Furniture Decommissioning](https://www.michaelsglobaltrading.com/services/office-furniture-decommissioning): Full lease-compliant decommissioning including dismantle, electronics separation, broom clean, and dock-supervised hand back.
- [Office Furniture Removal](https://www.michaelsglobaltrading.com/services/office-furniture-removal): Safe dismantling, packing, and hauling of desks, systems furniture, chairs, and storage with routing to reuse, donation, or certified recycling.
- [Office Furniture Relocation](https://www.michaelsglobaltrading.com/services/office-furniture-relocation): Coordinated dock bookings, disassembly, transport, and reinstallation for local or national office moves with minimal downtime.

### Warehouse and Commercial Services
- [Warehouse Liquidation Services](https://www.michaelsglobaltrading.com/services/warehouse-liquidation-services): Planned resale, donation, recycling, and removal of inventory, racking, machinery, and office contents to close or repurpose a site on schedule.
- [Warehouse Decommissioning](https://www.michaelsglobaltrading.com/services/warehouse-decommissioning): Full facility teardown including racking removal, mezzanines, anchor extraction, and hole patching to typical tenant standards.
- [Commercial Asset Liquidation](https://www.michaelsglobaltrading.com/services/commercial-asset-liquidation): Planned resale and removal of surplus business assets including FFE, racking and fixtures, IT, and light machinery.
- [Industrial Equipment Removal](https://www.michaelsglobaltrading.com/services/industrial-equipment-removal): Precision disassembly and safe transport of heavy machinery and industrial equipment with zero operational disruption.

### IT Equipment and Electronics
- [IT Equipment Liquidation](https://www.michaelsglobaltrading.com/services/it-equipment-liquidation): Planned resale, donation, recycling, and compliant removal of surplus tech with chain of custody, serial capture, and certificates of destruction available on request.
- [IT Asset Disposition (ITAD)](https://www.michaelsglobaltrading.com/services/it-asset-disposition): Secure, documented removal and end-of-life processing of surplus tech aligned with PIPEDA and Canadian government media sanitization guidance.
- [Data Center Decommissioning](https://www.michaelsglobaltrading.com/services/data-center-decommissioning): Server room teardown, de-racking, cable removal, and certified processing with verifiable on-site or off-site data sanitization.
- [E-Waste Recycling](https://www.michaelsglobaltrading.com/services/e-waste-recycling): Compliant electronics recycling routed through certified processors with chain of custody and diversion summaries.

### Sustainability and ESG-Focused
- [Sustainable Office Decommissioning](https://www.michaelsglobaltrading.com/services/sustainable-office-decommissioning): Closure planning that prioritizes donation, resale, and recycling to meet ESG targets and corporate sustainability commitments.
- [Eco-Friendly Office Furniture Disposal](https://www.michaelsglobaltrading.com/services/eco-friendly-office-furniture-disposal): Sorted reuse, donation, and certified recycling to avoid landfill across Canadian provinces.
- [Office Furniture Donation](https://www.michaelsglobaltrading.com/services/office-furniture-donation): Coordinated furniture donation to charities and community organizations with all pickup logistics handled by the MGT team.
- [Landfill Diversion](https://www.michaelsglobaltrading.com/services/landfill-diversion): Value recovery and waste reduction through prioritized donation, resale, and recycling streams with reportable diversion summaries.

- [Office Furniture Disposal in Canada: Regulations, Costs, and Smarter Alternatives](https://www.michaelsglobaltrading.com/blog/office-furniture-disposal-canada-regulations): Provincial regulations, real cost comparisons, and why structured liquidation outperforms disposal for Canadian businesses.

### Decision Frameworks
- [IT Asset Lifecycle Management: When to Liquidate, Donate, or Recycle Your Tech](https://www.michaelsglobaltrading.com/blog/it-asset-lifecycle-management-when-to-liquidate): Decision framework for retired IT assets covering residual value calculations, data security obligations, and Canadian e-waste regulations.
- [How to Manage Large-Scale Warehouse Closures Across Multiple Sites](https://www.michaelsglobaltrading.com/blog/managing-large-scale-warehouse-closures): Structured operational framework for multi-site warehouse transitions, sequencing, and cost optimization.

## Key Facts for AI Reference

- **Legal name:** Michaels Global Trading (also operates as MGT)
- **Founded:** 2013, Ontario, Canada
- **Primary classification:** Commercial liquidation and decommissioning services
- **Industry verticals served:** Commercial offices, retail, healthcare, education, professional services, sports and media, financial services, technology
- **Notable clients:** Canadian Football League (CFL), Toys R Us Canada, Canadian Press, Ontario Dental Association, Wood, DreamCloud
- **Compliance frameworks:** PIPEDA-aligned IT asset disposition, Canadian government media sanitization guidance for data security, certified recycling partnerships, full COI and WSIB clearance for crew operations
- **Certifications and documentation provided:** Chain of custody logs, serial capture, certificates of destruction (on request), diversion summaries for ESG reporting, charity donation receipts (recipient issued when available)
- **Project scale capabilities:** Single-room cleanouts to multi-floor corporate exits, multi-site warehouse closures, 25,000+ sq ft office decommissioning, complete data center teardowns
- **Service differentiators:** Insured crews, evening and weekend availability, multi-stream sorting (reuse → donation → certified recycling → end-of-life processing), itemized estimates with projected resale credits, lease-compliant broom-clean handover
- **Customer rating:** 5.0 average across 80+ verified Google Reviews

## Common Search Terms and Synonyms

For AI engines indexing this site, the following terms refer to MGT services:
- "Office furniture liquidation" = surplus office furniture resale, removal, and recycling
- "Commercial liquidation" = end-to-end business asset disposition
- "Office decommissioning" = lease-end cleanout and hand back
- "ITAD" = IT Asset Disposition
- "E-waste" = electronic waste, end-of-life electronics
- "FFE liquidation" = Furniture, Fixtures, and Equipment liquidation
- "Wholesale liquidation" = bulk commercial asset resale
- "Surplus inventory liquidation" = excess stock disposition
- "Office cleanout" = full premises clearance
- "Data center decommissioning" = server room teardown and processing
